dashboard_line: Vault scan: 11 issues (3 HIGH, 5 MEDIUM, 3 LOW); orphaned links & metadata gaps

findings.description: References [[investigation-1]], [[investigation-2]], [[investigation-3]] but these docs do not exist in vault. These are placeholder links never materialized as actual investigations.
findings.impact: Readers clicking these links will fail in Obsidian; breaks discoverability pattern
findings.suggested_fix: Remove placeholder references OR create actual investigation docs. Current status: placeholder links should be deleted; replace with real active investigations from dashboard snapshot.

findings.description: References [[skills-audit-free-model-readiness]] as 'Discovered work queued' but doc does not exist. Listed as if it's a canonical vault doc with manifest artifacts.
findings.impact: Link appears authoritative (implies manifest exists) but the doc is missing entirely. Breaks credibility chain.
findings.suggested_fix: Either: (1) Create 03-skills-audit-free-models.md as a canonical doc, OR (2) Remove reference and document discovery in manifests/artifacts/ instead. Current design stores artifacts in forensics/, not vault, so this should not appear as a vault doc reference.

findings.description: Related section references [[mcp-server-architecture]] without full wiki name prefix (missing '03-' numbering). Inconsistent wikilink style (should match breadcrumb format).
findings.impact: May not resolve in strict Obsidian; inconsistency with naming convention established in other docs

findings.description: DASHBOARD lacks breadcrumb navigation. All other docs have **Breadcrumb:** at top; dashboard should have entry point marker per 09-vault-architecture rules.
findings.impact: Readers cannot navigate up from dashboard; breaks braiding pattern for vault entry point
findings.suggested_fix: Add breadcrumb: **Breadcrumb:** [VAULT ROOT] or **Breadcrumb:** [[00-DASHBOARD]] (self-reference, indicating entry point)

findings.description: Docs 02-05 include YAML frontmatter (task_id, investigation_label, status, created) but docs 01, 06-10 do NOT. This creates inconsistency in vault document format.
findings.impact: Mixed schema: some docs are task artifacts (with YAML), others are reference docs (no YAML). Confuses intent: are these task work products or canonical vault docs?
findings.suggested_fix: DECISION REQUIRED: (1) Remove YAML frontmatter from 02-05 (treat as canonical vault docs), OR (2) Add task_id/investigation_label to docs 01, 06-10 (treat all as task artifacts). Currently ambiguous.

findings.description: Breadcrumb nesting goes 3 levels deep: [[00-DASHBOARD]] > [[02-settings-sync-strategy]] > [[01-forensic-governance]]. Per 09-vault-architecture, optimal is ≤2 hops from root.
findings.impact: Confusing navigation: why does 02 point back to 01 in breadcrumb? Expected: linear chain 00→01→02→03→04→05 or star pattern from 00
findings.suggested_fix: Straighten breadcrumb to: [[00-DASHBOARD]] > [[02-settings-sync-strategy]]. Remove back-reference to 01. Let wikilinks table handle relationships.

findings.description: Both docs cover nearly identical scope: MCP deployment steps, prerequisites, networking, systemd service setup. Differ only in infrastructure (VPS vs. ZimaBoard). Heavy duplication of procedures; should consolidate into one doc with infrastructure-agnostic steps + variants section.
findings.impact: Maintenance burden: changes to deployment process must be updated in 2 places. Risk of drift (VPS instructions get updated, ZimaBoard doesn't).
findings.suggested_fix: Consolidate: Create 04-mcp-deployment-guide.md (infrastructure-agnostic) with sections: '## VPS Deployment (DigitalOcean, Linode)' and '## ZimaBoard Deployment (Personal Hardware)'. Delete or archive separate VPS/ZimaBoard docs.

findings.description: Breadcrumb shows [[05-mcp-deployment-zimaboard]] > [[04-mcp-deployment-vps]] but Navigation Table does not list a 'Next' option. Linear chain breaks; no onward edge defined.
findings.impact: Readers cannot navigate forward; unclear what comes after ZimaBoard deployment guide
findings.suggested_fix: Add '→ Next' row or clarify: 'Next: [[00-DASHBOARD]] (return to system status)' OR define what logical work follows deployment (testing guide? Operations guide?)

findings.description: Dashboard has timestamp but NO **Status:** field. Other canonical docs declare status (CANONICAL, LOCKED, Ready for implementation, etc). Dashboard should clarify its status.
findings.impact: Unclear if dashboard is a fixed reference (locked) or living document (editable). Breaks metadata consistency.
findings.suggested_fix: Add **Status:** to dashboard footer. Example: **Status:** LIVING DOCUMENT — Updated per session. Last refresh: 2026-04-28 10:44 UTC

findings.description: Some references use full doc names ([[03-mcp-server-architecture]]), others use shorthand ([[mcp-server-architecture]], [[forensic-governance]], [[settings-sync]]). Inconsistent style.
findings.impact: Some links may fail in strict Obsidian if shorthand names aren't configured as aliases
findings.suggested_fix: Standardize: Always use full numbered names ([[03-mcp-server-architecture]] not [[mcp-server-architecture]]). Or configure Obsidian aliases for shorthand versions.

findings.description: Doc 06 is FOUNDATIONAL (defines investigation lifecycle, validation criteria) but positioned as 6th in sequence. Readability would improve if it appeared earlier in onboarding flow (docs 07-10 reference it heavily).
findings.impact: New readers following breadcrumb 00→01→02→...→06 won't see investigation fundamentals until doc 6. Better order: 00, 07 (CODEX), 06 (INVESTIGATIONS), then infrastructure docs.
findings.location: Entire doc position in vault sequence
findings.suggested_fix: Renumber: Move 06 earlier in canonical sequence (before deployment docs). Suggest new order: 00-DASHBOARD, 07-CODEX, 06-INVESTIGATIONS, 08-GOVERNANCE, then infrastructure 01-05. OR: explicitly mark 06 as 'foundational reference' in dashboard, suggesting it be read early.

critical_issues: Orphaned wikilinks to non-existent docs (investigation-1/2/3, skills-audit-free-model-readiness)
Missing breadcrumb on DASHBOARD entry point
Inconsistent frontmatter schema (some docs have task_id YAML, others don't)
summary.structural_health: YELLOW (72/100) — Good overall braiding, but orphaned links and ambiguous formatting reduce confidence
next_actions: 1. Delete placeholder references OR materialize investigation docs (HIGH priority)
3. Resolve frontmatter inconsistency across all docs (MEDIUM priority)
4. Consolidate MCP deployment guides into single doc with variants (MEDIUM priority)

agent_notes: Vault has excellent overall structure (clear hierarchy, good wikilink coverage, strong braiding). Primary issues are: (1) placeholder links left unfilled, (2) mixed frontmatter schema creating ambiguity about doc type, (3) MCP deployment duplication. These are consolidation/cleanup tasks, not fundamental design flaws. Recommend fixer scout to execute HIGH fixes first, then MEDIUM cleanup.
